explanation.text: The Logic: Gamma is POSITIVE for ALL long (bought) options and NEGATIVE for all short (sold) options. - Long call: positive gamma - Long put: positive gamma - Short call: negative gamma - Short put: negative gamma The Trap: Gamma sign depends on whether you are long or short, NOT on whether it is a call or put. Cross-Exam Context: Positive gamma benefits from large moves. Negative gamma (writers) suffers from large moves. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Long options = positive gamma (benefit from moves). Short options = negative gamma (hurt by moves).
